guidanceReasoning: Problem: selecting the neutral package before art direction made unrelated game tasks look like the same generic app.

New game direction: inspect reference pixels, decide composition/material/type/subject/control/state treatment, build one complete task, obtain appropriate art, compare captures and get a fresh critique before first delivery.

Images are optional where native graphic art, text-led design or deliberate restraint fits. Post professional mail is a valid quiet counterexample; the guidance preserves existing style for small edits and does not prescribe genre skins.
Keep examples and scoring tasks in evaluation artifacts. Consumer guidance states the reusable causes and exact Facet contracts, without imposing these screen inventories or assets.
The one-line probe change passes game explicitly to Verify collection so live Studio evidence does not fall back to a restricted environment lookup.
